Distra 0.1.0

The first full release of Distra, a Discord mod for iOS. Built and tested against **Discord 348.0 (113691)**.

> [!WARNING]
> Unofficial modification, not affiliated with Discord. Client mods break Discord's Terms of Service; use at your own risk. Plugins run with full access to your account: only enable what you understand.

## Downloads

| File | For |
| --- | --- |
| **Distra.ipa** | Discord 348.0 with Distra injected, for sideloading (AltStore, SideStore, Sideloadly, TrollStore…). Includes the Plumpy and Iconsax icon packs from rosiecord. |
| **Distra.dylib** | Inject into Discord yourself (LiveContainer, IPA patchers). No Substrate needed. |
| **…iphoneos-arm.deb** / **…iphoneos-arm64.deb** | Rootful / rootless jailbreak packages. |
| distra.js | The JS bundle on its own (already embedded in all of the above). |

IPAs are only published with full releases; the rolling [beta](https://github.com/OMetaVR/Distra/releases/tag/beta) has the dylib and .debs.

## What's in it

- Runs plugins written for **Vendetta**, **Bunny/Revenge**, **Enmity** and **Aliucord**, managed from a Distra section in Discord's own settings.
- **98 built-in plugins**, all off until you turn them on in *Settings > Distra > Plugin Library*:
  - 5 of Distra's own: **Message Logger** (deleted messages and edit history, greyed-out deleted images), **Platform Indicators**, **Radial Status**, **Hide Chat Buttons** (with swipe to collapse) and **Fake Nitro**.
  - 93 community plugins, pinned to their upstream source and patched for Discord 348. Each was enabled and checked on a device alongside the others; results are in [docs/PLUGIN_TESTING.md](https://github.com/OMetaVR/Distra/blob/main/docs/PLUGIN_TESTING.md).
- Icon packs and extra app icons.
- Crash-loop protection with an automatic safe mode, an on-device log viewer (three-finger long press), and a remote debugger for development.

## Known limits

- Only Discord 348.0 is supported. Other versions may load but plugin fixes target 348.
- Themes are not supported yet (planned).
- Some plugins have open issues; the Plugin Library marks them, and [PLUGIN_TESTING.md](https://github.com/OMetaVR/Distra/blob/main/docs/PLUGIN_TESTING.md) lists what each one was checked for.

Distra is licensed under GPL-3.0-or-later. Built-in plugins keep their own licenses; credits in [builtin-plugins/README.md](https://github.com/OMetaVR/Distra/blob/main/builtin-plugins/README.md).

# uYouEnhanced v21.20.4-3.0.5

> **Note:** `uYou 3.0.5` in this release is an **Unofficial Update**, a patched build of MiRO92's uYou 3.0.4 with modern-uYou download fixes applied on top by uYouEnhanced. It is not an official release by MiRO92.

## DIY (Build uYouEnhanced Yourself) 🛠️

This decision was made because uYouEnhanced and other similar tweaks have been subject to DMCA takedowns by Google. As a result, IPA files cannot be publicly released or hosted on this platform. Please read the [Wiki - Building](https://github.com/arichornlover/uYouEnhanced/wiki/Building) guide for building your own uYouEnhanced ipa.

## What's Big in 21.20.4-3.0.5 🚀

**uYou Downloads Actually Complete Now** | The download pipeline was reworked again and this time it's solid: video downloads finish (with audio muxed when available) and audio-only downloads land as real audio files instead of silent video. Also fixed the "unsupported URL" (`-1002`) failures on newer YouTube builds, fixed the uYou button crashing on the new Shorts button interface, and swapped uYou's old MobileFFmpeg framework for **FFmpegKitNext 9.0.0** for faster, more reliable muxing/converting.
Note: this still relies on SABR downloading via YouMod, and Shorts downloading remains broken for now (crash was only fixed for stability for uYouEnhanced).

**uYouEnhanced Debug Logs** | A new **uYouEnhanced Debug Logs** button in Settings exports a full, timestamped log of tweak activity one of the most useful additions yet for diagnosing and reporting problems. Log contents will vary with the YouTube version you're on and could be very useful for bug reports!

**iOS 26.5 SDK** | Switched the build SDK from `18.6` to `26.5` (originally planned for `21.14.4-3.0.5`) and fixed everything in uYouEnhanced that broke with the newer SDK. **Warning:** Do not use the iOS 27+ SDKs as they are not supported/buildable for uYouEnhanced atm, which includes tweaks like Alderis color picker.

**YouMod 2.0.0 Migration** | The YouMod migration was updated from `1.3.0` to `2.0.0` (YouMod is by [@Tonwalter888](https://github.com/Tonwalter888) — please show them support!). It is **not** backwards compatible and things are very different this time, so if you migrated on 1.3.0, but still use uYouEnhanced then please migrate again in this release.

**Lots of Polish & Fixes** | 25 issues solved in total, outdated uYouEnhanced options modernized, a reimagined **Red Progress Bar** toggle (YouSlider-based), the **Credits** screen evolved, **YTHoldForSpeed** restored, the **YouTube Sign-In Patch** is now always-on (no longer a toggle), and stale hooks for classes removed from modern YouTube were cleaned up.

## uYouEnhanced Features

-   **Notifications Tab** | Restores the pre-2020 Pivot Bar Notifications tab with customization options, now with position control.
-   **BackUp & Restore PLUS Settings** | Copy/paste your tweak settings via clipboard or file, including tweak-compatible extras beyond uYouPlus.
-   **uYouEnhanced Debug Logs** | Export a detailed activity log straight from Settings to help troubleshoot and report issues.
-   **BigYTMiniPlayer** | Brings back the classic big mini player bar with video info on iPhone (and works on the modern YouTube mini player too).
-   **Red Progress Bar** | A reimagined red progress bar, rebuilt from YouSlider-based code (conflicts with YouSlider — only one can be enabled).
-   **YouTimeStamp** | Copy the video URL with the exact timestamp for easy sharing.
-   **Low Contrast Mode** | Dims labels and icons for a less bright interface (specific app versions only).
-   **Fake YouTube Premium** | Premium-style logo and buttons for a premium appearance.
-   **No Heatwaves** | Removes the heatwave effect in the video player.
-   **No Upgrade Dialog** | Disables YouTube's update prompts.
-   **App Settings Overlay Options** | Hide sections like Account, Autoplay, and more.
-   **App Version Spoofer** | Spoof the app version number when needed.
-   **uYou 3.0.5 (Unofficial, downloads fixed)** | All original uYou download features (video/audio downloads, conversion, metadata) are now powered by uYouEnhanced's reworked download pipeline, with FFmpegKitNext 9.0.0 handling muxing and conversion.

## Release Information

Current YouTube Version: `v21.20.4`  
Current uYou Version: `v3.0.5` *(Unofficial Update of 3.0.4)*  
Current App Compatibility: `iOS/iPadOS 16.0` or later.

-   Fixed: uYou downloads not completing / silent audio-only downloads (audio was being saved as video)

# EeveeSpotify 7.0.0

A ground-up overhaul of the tweak's interface, built around native **iOS 26 Liquid Glass**, plus a redesigned settings app, a remote flag browser, and a large batch of stability and privacy fixes.
---

## ✨ Liquid Glass UI *(iOS 26)*

A new opt-in rendering layer that replaces Spotify's stock chrome with real system glass, toggleable surface-by-surface — take the tab bar without touching the player.

- **Tab bar** — a genuine `UITabBar` rendered as native glass, with taps replayed onto Spotify's own tab items
- **Now Playing bar** — glass capsule with album-colour tinting
- **Spotify's own bars & menus** — existing blur views swapped for real `UIGlassEffect`
- **Player, lyrics, search, home, and page headers**
- **Playlist, album, and artist** glass action rows, with header and Home section controls
- **Custom lyrics view** — optional glass rendering, with the button hidden automatically when no lyrics are fetched

## 🎛️ Tab bar customization

Reorder tabs, hide tabs you never tap, hide labels for an icon-only bar, choose a launch tab, and pin any Spotify page as a custom tab. Liked Songs, Downloads, Podcasts, and Queue ship as presets; any `spotify:` URI can be added. Custom tabs navigate in-app rather than bouncing to your other Spotify install.

## 🎨 Appearance

- **AMOLED black theme** — see [Credits](#-credits) below
- **Custom accent colours** and **custom background colours**
- **Rounded playlist cover art** for library rows and playlist track rows
- **Dynamic background colours** pulled from album art
- **Home gradient control** — style (gradient or solid), height (short, medium, tall), strength, fade curve, and per-page targeting for Home, Library, and Search
- **Player backdrop** and **glass lyrics card** toggles

## 🎧 Player

Control decluttering, double-tap seek/skip zones, haptics for buttons and scrubbing, and direct access to Word-Synced lyrics.

## 📜 Lyrics & karaoke

The biggest change here: **word-synced lyrics now work in the custom lyrics view**, not just on Spotify's own lyrics screen.

- **Word-synced support for the custom lyrics view**, with a dedicated on/off toggle gating the rest of the section
- **Customisable blur intensity** (0–6) for inactive lyric lines
- **Other lyrics sources can now use line-synced mode**, not just Spicy Lyrics
- **Credits footer** with real attribution — who wrote, provided, and uploaded the lyrics
- **Official Spicy Lyrics API** with a configurable key, in-app validation, and a link to the key template
- Lyrics uncensoring fill, RTL karaoke highlighting, text alignment and reversed-direction controls

## 🔧 New settings surfaces

- **Remote flag browser** — browse, search, and override Spotify's server-side feature flags, with change-only filtering and per-flag reset
- **Curated Spotify Features page** — hidden switches Spotify already ships (trim silence, library Pro, denser rows, lock-screen options, sleep timer, and more)
- **Redesigned settings** grouped into Listening / Looks / Advanced, with per-page previews, page-level resets, and a Troubleshooting section
- **Debug logging** with export and clear

## 🛡️ Privacy & stability

- **Blocks third-party tracking SDKs** — Firebase, Facebook, Branch, and other analytics
- **Hide Jam** — strips Jam entry points from the app without touching tracks or artists that happen to be titled "Jam"
- **Blocks App Store rating prompts** — no more review popups interrupting playback
- Resolves an access-token race crash, a karaoke long-press scope bug, settings tint leaks, and assorted stability issues

---

## 🐛 Fixes in this release

### Custom lyrics view didn't update between songs

The biggest fix. Previously, opening the custom lyrics view pinned it to whatever song was playing at that moment — skip to the next track and it kept showing the old lyrics until you closed and reopened it.

It now follows the player: when the track changes, it swaps in the new song's lyrics and resets scroll position and per-line state so each song starts fresh. If the new track's lyrics aren't in hand yet, it fetches them and retries a few times before giving up.

It also tracks the **actually playing** track rather than the one a lyrics request last named — Spotify preloads lyrics for upcoming songs, so the old behaviour could latch onto the wrong one. If no lyrics turn up at all, the view closes itself instead of sitting there empty.

### iPad Liquid Glass layout

- **Tab bar rendered too small** — the glass bar inherited Spotify's short iPad strip height, squashing every item. Now floored at 50pt and centred on the original strip.
- **Album art escaped the mini player** — clipping was applied inside a radius check that iPad's capsule radius skipped entirely, so artwork bled past the corners. Clipping is now unconditional, and the artwork search is iPad-aware.

### Localisations

- Non-English tables brought in line with English
- Version appearance simplified, build number surfaced in-app
- "Rounded artwork" renamed to **"Rounded playlist cover art"** across all 27 languages

---

Locally built IPAs now ship with the alternate app icons baked in, and the deb dependency was corrected.

---

| | |
|---|---|
| Minimum iOS | **16.1** |
| Liquid Glass | iOS 26 + restart |
| Languages | **27** |
| Alternate app icons | **34** |
| Spotify | 9.1.x |

Sign the IPA with **SideStore**, **FlareStore**, or a certificate-based signer like **RyukSign**. For jailbroken devices, grab the `.deb` matching your architecture from the releases page.

### Hide Jam & block rating prompts

**Hide Jam** and **Block rating prompts** were proposed and implemented by **[Incognito-Coder](https://github.com/Incognito-Coder)** in **[PR #152](https://github.com/SideloadLabs/EeveeSpotifyReincarnated/pull/152)** (*feat: hide Jam from menus and block app star rating dialogs*).

Clean Share Links strips it for the share sheet, clipboard, and direct share targets, but the Messages route isn't covered yet. - Say why a **RedGIFs** post couldn't load instead of "RedGIFs error :(", such as removed, not found, not available in your region, or RedGIFs can't be reached (#1359: @icpryde)
- Keep a fullscreen **GIF or video** playing behind the comments sheet you open with **Swipe Up for Comments**, instead of it stopping or the screen going black (#1277: @Thetromboneman1)
- Fade the background when you drag a fullscreen image or video away sideways or at an angle, not only straight up or down (#1320: @ryannair05)
- Fix touching and holding a **modmail** or private message doing nothing on Liquid Glass, and long messages ending in a band of empty space (#1307, #1308: @icpryde)
- Keep **Google** search's cookies across launches on iOS 16 and earlier, so Google stops asking you to sign in or pass its check every time (#1315: @icpryde)
- Fix the **GIF picker**'s search bar looking double-layered on Liquid Glass (#1283: @icpryde)

- Fix **Apollo Reborn settings** footers and subtitles growing to body size under Rounded, Serif, and Monospaced theme fonts, and headers and footers keeping the old theme after you change it in **Theme Manager** (#1293, #1297, #1322: @icpryde)
- Stop the **Apollo AI** settings list jumping while you scroll it, after a cancelled swipe-back, and when you come back to it (#1288, #1291: @icpryde)
- Keep the section titles in **Settings Shortcuts** still when you add or remove a shortcut, and on non-Liquid-Glass builds open its menu over the screen you're on when you hold the Settings tab, instead of switching to Settings first (#1355, #1384: @icpryde, @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Stop the **iPad** tab bar covering page titles and the Search tab's search field on Liquid Glass; titles and search fields now get their own row below the tabs (#1314: @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - **Move Tab Bar to Bottom** is now **Tab Bar Position** (Interface → Tab Bar, Top by default), and the tabs keep their text labels in either position
- Reduce post and comment text and icons blanking out on **Mac** when you switch to or away from Apollo (#1301: @Thetromboneman1)


</details>
